features.description: Extend plan.schema.json + Pydantic mirror with orchestration / child_charter / commit_policy as documented additive properties. Bump agent-conventions VERSION 1.8.0 → 1.9.0 in DontPanic subtree mirror. Append CHANGELOG.md entry. The schema currently has `additionalProperties: false` at the root and these three properties aren't declared, causing every locked plan since v3 to fail strict `jsonschema.validate` even though the runtime accepts them via direct attribute access in plan_loader. Strictly additive — no new required fields, existing plans must validate after the change. Each new property gets a `description` field with example shape so future plan authors don't guess. The Pydantic mirror at claude/shared/schemas/v1.0/models/plan_model.py is updated in tandem to declare matching Optional fields with documented types (orchestration is an Object with parent_plan_id/spawn_reason/depth_limit; child_charter is an Object with kind/parent_objective/parent_acceptance_item/allowed_paths/forbidden_decisions/return_condition_summary/may_edit_product_code; commit_policy is an Object with mode + requires).
steps: Read claude/shared/schemas/v1.0/plan.schema.json. Confirm `additionalProperties: false` at root + absence of orchestration/child_charter/commit_policy. Document the current property set.

Add three new properties to plan.schema.json with full internal structure: orchestration (parent_plan_id string, spawn_reason enum operator_manual|auto|test, depth_limit integer minimum 1), child_charter (kind enum implementation|investigation|migration, parent_objective string, parent_acceptance_item string, allowed_paths array of strings, forbidden_decisions array of strings, return_condition_summary string, may_edit_product_code boolean), commit_policy (mode enum child_commit|parent_commit|manual, requires array of strings).
For each new property, include a `description` field with concrete example values lifted from a real locked plan (e.g., v4.1 plan 2026-05-12-002).

Update claude/shared/schemas/v1.0/models/plan_model.py: add Optional[Orchestration], Optional[ChildCharter], Optional[CommitPolicy] fields to the Plan model. Define the sub-models (Orchestration, ChildCharter, CommitPolicy) with matching Pydantic field types + documentation strings. Pydantic mirror MUST validate the same plans the JSON schema validates.

Append claude/shared/CHANGELOG.md entry: ## 1.9.0 — 2026-05-19 / ### Added / - orchestration, child_charter, commit_policy properties to plan schema (additive; motivated by Roadmap Plan 3 — every locked plan since v3 declared these implicitly).

Add fixture tests in scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_plan_schema_v19_additive_orchestration_fields.py covering: (a) v4.1 plan.md frontmatter validates clean against v1.9 schema, (b) Pydantic Plan model accepts the same frontmatter dict, (c) old plan without these fields (e.g., a synthetic minimal plan) still validates (backward compat), (d) malformed orchestration block (wrong type) fails validation with helpful error.
Run full orchestrator sweep + sanitization check. Confirm parsing-category emission (from v4.1) is unaffected.

features.description: Add a doctor probe that runs full strict jsonschema validation against every locked plan in docs/plans/. Walks plan dirs, parses plan.md frontmatter, validates against the v1.9 schema (now consistent with the runtime). Two modes: default = advisory (emits warnings with per-plan results); --strict = blocker exit code on any failure. After F001 lands, every existing locked plan validates clean under both modes. This becomes the doctor probe that Plan 2's widening can confidently rely on (no false-fails because the schema and runtime are now in sync).
steps: Read scripts/dontpanic_doctor.py. Find the existing probe registration pattern.

Add validate_plans_strict() helper that walks docs/plans/, loads each plan.md frontmatter via yaml.safe_load, runs jsonschema.validate against claude/shared/schemas/v1.0/plan.schema.json. Returns list[ValidationResult] with per-plan status (clean / warn / fail) + plan_id + error message if any.
Add the probe to the doctor's probe registry. Default mode = advisory (emits warnings, exit 0). New CLI flag --validate-plans-strict makes failures blockers (exit 2).
Wire output: pretty terminal output groups results by status; JSON output (existing --json flag) includes the new probe with per-plan detail array.

Add fixture tests in scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_doctor_validate_plans_strict_f003.py: (a) all current locked plans validate clean post-F001 fix; (b) a synthetic plan with malformed frontmatter fails strict mode with helpful per-field error; (c) --strict exit code path returns 2 on failure; (d) advisory mode returns 0 even with failures + emits warning lines.
Run doctor against the live locked-plan set; confirm zero blockers across all current plans (this is the post-fix regression net).
